europe_now.title: German Chancellor Visits Kyiv Amid Russian Strikes
europe_now.summary: German Chancellor Merz traveled to Kyiv to meet with Ukrainian officials while Russian airstrikes hit the capital. Officials emphasized that Ukraine will continue to require substantial international support.

europe_now.title: US Withdraws Bombers from British Base
europe_now.summary: The United States military has withdrawn all B-1 bombers from the RAF Fairford military base in Britain. The Pentagon announced the relocation following ongoing security and strategic reassessments.

top_stories.title: Elections and Political Shifts in Europe
top_stories.summary: Nationalist parties have secured leading positions following the divisive general election in Bosnia and Herzegovina. Meanwhile, the Latvian prime minister successfully maintained power as regional security concerns heavily influenced the parliamentary vote.

top_stories.title: Escalation in the Ukraine Conflict
top_stories.summary: Moscow announced plans to increase military strikes on Ukraine following recent vows from Kyiv to target Russian oil refineries. The ongoing conflict continues to draw intense diplomatic engagement and security responses from European leaders.
